nodes.label: S-166 Gate: 0.5.2 Core Gaps and Ride-Alongs
Discriminated Search-Failure Signal
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes upstream skills.sh search failures (fetch throw and HTTP !res.ok) from zero results via a discriminated-absent failed flag on primary queries only, keeping success JSON byte-identical to 0.5.1 while rendering explicit failure messaging on both web and TUI.

nodes.label: Update-Check Error Rendering and Bound-Port Surfacing
nodes.rationale: Renders per-skill update-check errors and not-checkable counts on both web and TUI, raises skills ls timeout from 120s to 300s, and passes the synchronous Bun.serve boundPort into rendered pages so settings hints report the actual bound port.
